entries.problem: The aluminium-filter cleaning indicator appears on the display
entries.possibleCause: The indicator appears after approximately 60 hours of fan operation and means that the aluminium filters need cleaning.
entries.safeUserCheck: Clean the aluminium filters. With the hood switched off, clear the filter-cleaning indication by touching and holding the indicated control for approximately 3 seconds.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for the normal filter-cleaning reminder.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 24, ANZEIGE DER REINIGUNG DER ALUMINIUMFILTER

entries.possibleCause: During normal operation the grease filter collects grease and must be cleaned regularly. A filter saturated with grease is flammable.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the hood from the power supply before cleaning. Clean the aluminium grease filter every month in a dishwasher or by hand using a mild detergent or liquid soap, as described in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal grease-filter cleaning. Contact service if the hood has a fault that remains after normal filter maintenance.

entries.problem: Aluminium filter changes colour after being washed
entries.possibleCause: The manual states that the colour of the aluminium filter can change after it has been washed several times in a dishwasher.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required for the colour change alone.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for aluminium-filter discolouration alone. The manual states that this does not mean the filter is defective or needs replacement.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 27, REINIGUNG UND WARTUNG - WARTUNG

entries.possibleCause: When the hood operates in recirculation mode, the activated charcoal filter absorbs odours until it becomes saturated.
entries.safeUserCheck: If the hood is used in recirculation mode, replace the activated charcoal filter at least every 3 to 4 months, or more often with intensive use. The charcoal filter cannot be washed or regenerated.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal charcoal-filter replacement.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 27, REINIGUNG UND WARTUNG - AKTIVKOHLEFILTER

entries.problem: Hood fan starts automatically when the telescopic front panel is pulled out
entries.possibleCause: The telescopic hood has a limit switch. When the front panel is pulled out, the hood starts at the previously selected fan speed.
entries.safeUserCheck: No corrective action is required if the hood starts at the previously selected speed when the telescopic front is extended.
entries.claimTrigger: Do not create a service claim for this normal operating behaviour alone.
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 25, BEDIENUNG - STEUERUNG DER DUNSTABZUGSHAUBE

entries.problem: Fan-speed number flashes while the hood continues running
entries.possibleCause: A flashing fan-speed number indicates that the approximately 15-minute delayed switch-off timer is active.
entries.safeUserCheck: Allow the timer to finish, or push the telescopic panel in to cancel the delayed switch-off and turn the appliance off.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required when the flashing display is caused by the normal delayed switch-off timer.

entries.problem: Delayed switch-off timer needs to be cancelled
entries.possibleCause: The approximately 15-minute delayed switch-off function has been activated.
entries.safeUserCheck: Push the telescopic panel in to cancel the delayed switch-off function and turn off the appliance. Set the desired fan speed again if you want to continue using the hood.
entries.claimTrigger: No service claim is required for normal timer cancellation.

entries.possibleCause: The manual does not give a customer-repairable cause. It states that a damaged power cable must be replaced by a specialist service centre.
entries.safeUserCheck: Stop using the hood. Disconnect it from the power supply only if this can be done safely. Do not repair or replace the cable yourself.
entries.claimTrigger: Create an urgent service claim for a damaged power cable or exposed electrical parts.
evidenceToRequest: photo of the damaged cable if safe to take
description of when the damage was noticed

entries.possibleCause: The manual does not specify a fault cause. Replacement lighting must have the same parameters as the factory-installed light.
entries.safeUserCheck: Disconnect the hood from the power supply before maintenance. Use only a replacement light with the same parameters as the factory-installed component and follow the lighting-replacement figure in the manual.
entries.claimTrigger: Contact authorised service if the lighting module cannot be replaced using the procedure provided in the manual or if service intervention is required.
evidenceToRequest: photo or video showing the lighting problem
entries.sourceSection: PDF p. 27, REINIGUNG UND WARTUNG - BELEUCHTUNG
